title: Release-readiness documentation pass across all 42 packages
body:
Preparing the monorepo for formal npm publication: every `@objectstack/*` package needed consistent publishing metadata, a standardized README, and a corrected footprint in the docs site (which still claimed 27 packages — actual count is 42).

### Standardization
- New `docs/internal/PACKAGE_README_TEMPLATE.md` — canonical README structure, `package.json` publishing checklist, and pre-release PR gate. Single source of truth for future package additions.

### `package.json` normalization (all 42)
- Added missing `description`, `keywords` (≥3), full `repository` block with `directory`, `homepage`, `bugs`, `publishConfig.access: public`, `files` whitelist, `engines.node`, `author`.
- Version-aligned `@objectstack/service-tenant` (0.1.0) and `@objectstack/service-package` (1.0.0) to the `4.0.4` release train.

### READMEs
- Authored `packages/services/service-package/README.md` (was missing entirely — release blocker).
- Rewrote thin/stub READMEs to the canonical structure: `core`, `rest`, `driver-memory`, `plugin-security`, and all 7 adapters (`express`, `fastify`, `hono`, `nestjs`, `nextjs`, `nuxt`, `sveltekit`).
- Pre-existing detailed READMEs (e.g. `service-ai`, `service-storage`, `plugin-audit`, `runtime`, `spec`, `driver-sql`, `driver-turso`) left intact to preserve their depth.

### Docs site & root docs
- `content/docs/guides/packages.mdx` — corrected package count (27 → 42), added a category summary table, added `service-package` and `service-tenant` entries.
- `content/docs/concepts/packages.mdx` — corrected package count (25 → 42) and category breakdown.
- Root `README.md` — Services table now lists all 12; Plugins table gains `plugin-mcp-server`; Codebase Metrics count `27 → 42`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — release-prep entry.
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md` — new `v4.0.4 — Release Readiness` section with full inventory and verification checklist.

### Deferred (release pipeline)
- `content/docs/references/` regeneration via `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs`.
- `lychee` link check and `pnpm docs:build` as part of release CI.

### Example: normalized `package.json` tail

```json
"repository": {
  "type": "git",
  "url": "https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework.git",
  "directory": "packages/services/service-package"
},
"homepage": "https://objectstack.ai/docs",
"bugs": "https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/issues",
"keywords": ["objectstack", "service", "package", "registry", "marketplace"],
"publishConfig": { "access": "public" },
"files": ["dist", "README.md"],
"engines": { "node": ">=18.0.0" }
```
